title: Sea World Culture and Art Center
description: Join Jiamin Li to discover Shenzhen’s rise as China’s first UNESCO "City of Design"! Dive into its youthful energy, inclusive culture, and cutting-edge hubs like the Sea World Culture and Art Center. See how innovation thrives through sustainability, young talent, and events like Shenzhen Design Week.
